Privacy Policy

Clinical-grade privacy architecture and full data transparency for the AuraHealth Premium Wellness Tracker.

Application: AuraHealth Premium Tracker

🛡️ Core Privacy Guarantee

AuraHealth operates on an offline-first, zero-knowledge architectural model. Your biometrics, heart rate variability, nocturnal sleep hypnograms, and nutrition records belong exclusively to you. We NEVER sell, monetize, trade, or share your medical and telemetry records with third-party advertisers, insurance providers, or data brokers.

1. Data Collected & Processed

To provide high-precision autonomic recovery scoring, cardiac monitoring, and bodybuilding macronutrient optimization, AuraHealth processes the following categories of telemetry:

Category Specific Telemetry Points Usage Purpose
Cardiovascular & Vitals Resting Heart Rate (BPM), Heart Rate Variability (HRV ms), Blood Pressure (Systolic/Diastolic/MAP), Fasting Glucose, SpO2, Core Temperature, and ECG rhythm strips. Calculating physiological readiness scores and autonomous recovery baselines.
Sleep Architecture Nocturnal duration, sleep efficiency (%), Deep slow-wave sleep, REM phases, Light sleep, and Awake debt. Generating circadian hypnograms and sleep debt reduction insights.
Bodybuilder Nutrition Caloric intake, protein-to-bodyweight ratios (g/kg BW), carbohydrate/fat partitioning, dietary fiber, sodium intake, and supplement compliance logs. Calculating anabolic macronutrient distribution, glycogen balance, and vascularity support.
Physical Strain Cardiovascular strain scores (0–21), exercise logs, duration, and caloric burn. Determining exertion-to-recovery ratios.
User Profile & Account Athlete name, email address, password hash, age, biological sex, height, weight, and body fat %. Account authentication and biological baseline calculation.

2. Google Play Store Data Safety Declaration

  • Data Collected: Health & Fitness info, personal credentials.
  • Data Shared: NO data shared with third parties.
  • Data In-Transit Encryption: Enforced via HTTPS / TLS 1.3 protocol.
  • Data At-Rest Encryption: On-device encrypted AES-256 storage and encrypted cloud vaults (MongoDB Atlas).
  • Account & Data Deletion: Full 1-tap in-app self-service account deletion mechanism provided.

3. 1-Tap Account & Telemetry Deletion (Google Play Compliance)

In accordance with Google Play's Data Deletion Policy, users have an irrevocable right to permanently delete their account and purge all associated biometric records at any time:

In-App Deletion:

Navigate to Profile → Account & Security → Delete Account & Purge Telemetry. This immediately purges all local storage and all synchronized MongoDB cloud records permanently.

External Web Deletion Request:

If you have uninstalled the app or wish to request data purging via the web, email us at privacy@aurahealth.io with the subject "Account Deletion Request" from your registered email. Your request will be fulfilled and confirmed within 48 hours.

4. Children's Privacy (COPPA & GDPR-K)

AuraHealth is intended strictly for adults and competitive athletes. We do not knowingly collect personal or biometric information from children under 13 (or under 16 in the European Economic Area). Any account found to belong to an underage user will be deleted immediately.
